text: I wanted this... and I wanted this so we compromise and got this. I wanted this... and I wanted this so we compromise and got this. I wanted this... and I wanted this we compromise and got this. I wanted this... and I wanted this so we compromise and got this. Oh yeah, what a beautiful example of a compromise he says what he wants she says what she wants and then they compromise by buying what she wanted. Amazing. I get that it was probably just a sketch but this right here is how a lot of modern relationships work. It's not about finding balance, it's about him quietly giving up while she calls it teamwork. Look, I'm not saying you should fight over every decision. Compromise is part of any relationship but when every compromise means you lose and she wins, that's not a balance, that's a surrender. And the worst part? The guy doesn't even say a thing, he just makes a face and goes along, probably thinking that being agreeable will make things peaceful. It won't, it will just make her lose respect for him. A real relationship is not about one side always getting their way, it's about both sides giving up something for the other. Sometimes it's her decision, sometimes it's yours.
